name: Magic UI
summary: Open-source React components with animated effects for landing pages, installed from a shadcn registry or copied into your app.
description: Magic UI is a copy-paste component library for design engineers: animated and decorative React components built with Tailwind CSS and Motion - marquees, docks, globes, bento grids, beams, particles, text animations and more. The docs site serves 210 shadcn registry items with copy-paste examples, and Magic UI Pro adds paid landing page blocks and templates.
contains: components: marquee, dock, globe, bento grid, beams, meteors, particles, confetti, text animations
copy-paste source or install with the shadcn CLI
built with React, Tailwind CSS and Motion
Magic UI Pro adds 50+ paid blocks and templates
free Portfolio, Changelog and Blog templates
